entry.title: Weaponizing And Defending The React Flight Protocol: Deserialization Sinks In RSCs
entry.summary: While React Server Components rely on the custom Flight protocol to stream interactive UIs, this same mechanism introduces powerful deserialization sinks that attackers can exploit.
